pr_title: ESQL: Fix repeated rows in LOOKUP JOIN with a lookup index in the FROM

issue_context.title: ESQL lookup join with lookup index results in duplicate set of rows.
issue_context.body:
Performing a lookup join between 2 distinct lookup indices results in duplicated set of rows in result set:
```
~ ᐅ curl -XPOST "${ES_URL}/_query?format=txt" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d'{"query": "FROM languages"}'
     code      | code.keyword  |   language    |language.keyword
---------------+---------------+---------------+----------------
en             |en             |English        |English         
es             |es             |Spanish        |Spanish         
fr             |fr             |French         |French          
~ ᐅ curl -XPOST "${ES_URL}/_query?format=txt" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d'{"query": "FROM countries"}'
     code      | code.keyword  |   countries   |countries.keyword
---------------+---------------+---------------+-----------------
en             |en             |England        |England          
es             |es             |Spain          |Spain            
fr             |fr             |France         |France           
~ ᐅ curl -XPOST "${ES_URL}/_query?format=txt" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d'{"query": "FROM countries | LOOKUP JOIN languages ON code"}'
     code      |   countries   |countries.keyword| code.keyword  |   language    |language.keyword
---------------+---------------+-----------------+---------------+---------------+----------------
en             |null           |null             |en             |English        |English         
es             |null           |null             |es             |Spanish        |Spanish         
fr             |null           |null             |fr             |French         |French          
en             |England        |England          |en             |English        |English         
es             |Spain          |Spain            |es             |Spanish        |Spanish         
fr             |France         |France           |fr             |French         |French    
```
comments:
I believe this is related to https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/118865.

I think when a lookup index is used in the FROM, we do not construct the data node requests correctly. It nearly looks like we dump all the lookup index nodes into the `FROM` side in the ComputeService:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/17a6134e-8054-4e96-8569-96d78d058b0c)

When I generalize the example above and perform 2 lookups on distinct lookup indices when yet another lookup index is in the `FROM`, I get the rows from all those indices mashed together.

That may already be solved by https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/118768, but we need to add tests to confirm. I.e. a test case that uses multiple distinct lookup indices in the same query, both in the FROM and in the LOOKUP JOINs.

Looks like this is still happening in the current main.

A test like:
```
FROM languages_lookup_non_unique_key
| WHERE language_code == 1
| LOOKUP JOIN languages_lookup ON language_code
| KEEP language_code, language_name, country
| SORT language_code, language_name, country
;

language_code:integer | language_name:keyword       | country:text
1                     | English                     | Canada
1                     | English                     | United Kingdom
1                     | English                     | United States of America
1                     | English                     | null
;
```

Results in a duplicated last row

review_comments:
Extracted the `planConcreteIndices()` code here, and fixed it by adding the `node instanceof Join` check.
Looks like the Join was outside the fragment in the tests I used for the original PR, but it was inside for this case.
